_note: The twenty-one Manchester United poster tiles shown on /posters/ (moved off the front page on 2026-10-13). One tile per Etsy listing; image is the listing photo at 900x675 under public/shop/ and alt is that photo's Etsy alt text. Keep in step with src/data/posters.ts (inclusion rules in its header) and with the four tiles in index.html.
